edges.reason: onlyPrivileged compares msg.sender against owner/manager to gate privileged operations
approveMintRequest is guarded by onlyPrivileged
setIsEligible is guarded by onlyPrivileged
setIs1155 is guarded by onlyPrivileged
setManager is guarded by onlyPrivileged
finalizeVault is guarded by onlyPrivileged
closeVault is guarded by onlyPrivileged
msg.sender is mixed into the pseudo-random seed allowing miner/caller influence
block.timestamp (now) is used as pseudo-randomness source, timestamp dependency
migrateV1Tokens uses msg.sender as the token holder being migrated
migrateV1Tokens burns the caller balance via xToken.burnFrom before external transfer
migrateV1Tokens sends v2 tokens with an external ERC20 transfer
migrateV1Tokens requires isFullyMigrated to be true before migrating
migrateVaultToV2 sets isFullyMigrated when holdings reach zero
migrateVaultToV2 writes migrationPair for the v1 vault
migrateVaultToV2 mints v2 vault shares through INFTXVault.mint
migrateVaultToV2 calls approveERC721 for each migrated token
approveERC721 performs an arbitrary low-level call with attacker-influenced assetAddr
approveERC721 burns wrapped punks via WrappedPunks.burn
targetWithdraw transfers NFTs out with safeTransferFrom
targetWithdraw uses the legacy kitty transfer for vaults 7-9
targetWithdraw marks the vault fully migrated when empty
targetRedeem reuses the redeem helper which performs external NFT transfers
mint delegates to _mint for ERC721/1155 vaults
mint delegates to _mintD2 for D2 vaults
redeem delegates to _redeem for NFT vaults
redeem delegates to _redeemD2 for D2 vaults
_mint mints xTokens equal to deposited NFT count
_mint performs external NFT transferFrom calls before minting shares
_redeem calls _redeemHelper for each randomly selected NFT
_redeemHelper burns xTokens via burnFrom before external NFT transfers
_redeemHelper transfers NFTs to the caller after burning, reentrancy surface
_mintD2 mints xTokens for deposited D2 assets
_redeemD2 burns xTokens via burnFrom before returning D2 assets
approveMintRequest mints xTokens to the original requester
revokeMintRequests returns NFTs with safeTransferFrom
revokeMintRequests uses the legacy kitty transfer for vaults 7-9
revokeMintRequests requires the requester entry to equal msg.sender
onlyOwnerIfPaused allows msg.sender to bypass the pause when they are owner
onlyOwnerIfPaused reads the isPaused mapping for the pauser id
setPaused writes the isPaused mapping
transferOwnership updates the _owner state variable
initialize writes the store reference, only callable through the initializer
forceMigrationComplete lets the owner set isFullyMigrated unilaterally
_redeemHelper reads holdings, eligibility and NFT data from the store
approveMintRequest reads requesters, ownership and mints through the store
migrateVaultToV2 reads holdings and removes them through the store

normalization_plan.reason: param_v1VaultId is an input of the core migrateVaultToV2 function
param_v2VaultId is an input of the core migrateVaultToV2 function
param_count bounds the migration loop inside migrateVaultToV2
param_redeemAmount is the amount argument of the core redeem function
param_specificIds is the NFT id list of targetRedeem
param_to is the arbitrary destination used by targetWithdraw
local_data is the encoded calldata used by approveERC721's low-level call
local_ids is built and consumed inside migrateVaultToV2
local_amounts is built and consumed inside migrateVaultToV2
param_modulus bounds the output of the core _getPseudoRand function
local_rand is the pseudo-random index selected inside _redeem
param_vaultId identifies the vault targeted by the mint entry point
param_nftIds is the deposited NFT list processed by _mint
param_d2Amount is the D2 deposit amount of the mint entry point
param_boolean is the flag written by setIs1155
param_pauserId selects the pause slot written by setPaused
param_newOwner is the address written to _owner by transferOwnership
